user.title: Connect to your Orisec panel
user.description: Enter the address of the panel on your network and a user password it accepts.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of the panel.
data_description.password: A panel user password. Only ASCII characters are supported.
data_description.port: The UDP port the panel listens on. Leave the default unless you changed it.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your Orisec panel password
reauth_confirm.description: The panel at {host} rejected the stored password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the panel. Check the host, port and that the panel's LAN interface is enabled.

abort.wrong_panel: That address belongs to a different panel than the one being re-authenticated.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read zone status from the panel, in seconds.
